meta.name: geo-visibility
meta.description: Get cited and recommended by AI engines (ChatGPT, AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini). Input: a page or piece of content. Output: passage-level citability fixes (answer-first H2 blocks, self-contained chunks, definitions, sourced stats, comparison tables), a 5-pillar GEO score (0-100), an AI-crawler visibility check, and entity plus third-party consistency. Repo reference for citability. Use for GEO, AEO, LLM SEO, AI citations, citability, llms.txt, entity SEO, or why competitors appear in AI answers and you do not.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
